codegraphRoleSummary: CodeGraph is required for likely files, components, routes, shared source-of-truth, and related areas before Cursor work. This gate prevents accidental runtime activation, file mutation, or prompt auto-mutation until owner-approved read-only staging is configured.

stateDescriptions.not_configured: Contract and policies missing — CodeGraph runtime cannot be considered.
stateDescriptions.contract_ready: Contract and policies exist; runtime source not connected.
stateDescriptions.staging_ready_pending_owner: Mock static hints active; read-only staging runtime path prepared pending owner signoff and sanitized artifact or endpoint.
stateDescriptions.staging_enabled_read_only: Read-only CodeGraph discovery enabled in staging (artifact or endpoint) with safety gates active.
stateDescriptions.disabled_by_safety: Runtime temporarily disabled by safety policy or rollback.
stateDescriptions.failed_health_check: Health or artifact validation failed — mock static hints remain default.
